context.heading: But What About Liens Superior to a Tax Deed?
context.text: These are liens that were given special standing by the Florida legislature: county and municipal liens. How are these liens treated when a tax deed sale takes place? First, keep in mind that not every tax deed sale is going to have surplus funds. There will be many times when the winning bid is the starting bid. If your winning bid is above the starting bid, then there will be surplus funds. Which parties have access to surplus funds is determined by the priority given to that party under Florida statutes.
